an6.51:4.5: Then, just as he learned and memorized it, Venerable Ānanda teaches others in detail, makes them recite in detail, rehearses it himself in detail, and thinks about and considers the teaching in his heart, examining it with the mind.
an6.51:4.6: Venerable Ānanda enters the rains retreat in a monastery with senior mendicants who are very learned, inheritors of the heritage, who have memorized the teachings, the monastic law, and the outlines.
an6.51:4.7: From time to time Venerable Ānanda goes up to those mendicants and asks them questions:
an6.51:4.8: ‘Why, sir, does it say this? What does that mean?’
